chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever desires that the earth be folded for him, let him take al-nuqūd from the staff, and al-nuqūd is a staff of bitter almond wood.

key_terms.النُّقُدُ: a specific kind of staff mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.الْأَرْضُ: the earth or land, referring here to the distance of travel
key_terms.تُطْوَى: to be folded or made short, meaning travel is made easier or shortened
key_terms.لَوْزٍ مُرٍّ: bitter almond wood, the material from which the staff is made

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about carrying a staff to make travel easier?
ai.summary: This hadith recommends taking a particular kind of staff while traveling, describing it as a means by which travel is made easier. It identifies al-nuqūd as a staff made from bitter almond wood, within the etiquette and practice of travel.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2411 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever desires the earth to be folded for them (making travel easier), let them use al-nuqūd from the staff, and al-nuqūd is a staff made of bitter almond wood."
